citation.authors: Raffone A, Doglioli M, Aguzzi A, Girardi L et al
citation.journal: Facts, Views and Vision in ObGyn

record.design: Systematic review of how race and ethnicity are reported
record.finding: Only 65 studies (10.0%) reported participants' race or ethnicity, and the quality of that reporting was poor. The authors call for improved documentation.
record.note: Explains why endometriosis findings by ancestry are thin.
